notes.title: QoL Update | Auto raids & more
notes.notes: [p]This update is all about QoL and making your gameplay a little more pleasant and streamlined. Huge thanks to Uraxys and anyone else involved with the development of Idle Plus as a good chunk of these changes are inspired by the great work done there.[/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Raids[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new in-app purchase has been added that upon activation allows you to AFK raids. There is a single token, AFK Raider, that upon activation lets you choose which raid you'd like to gain the ability to AFK in. The token is as usual tradeable so you can buy it from other players via the player market as well. AFK raiding comes with a few caveats:[/p][list][*][p]You'll need to have completed a raid at least once to AFK it. In Bloodmoon Massacre, your able to base your AFK run based on waves you've managed to reach in manual runs. You're encouraged to do as well as you can in manual raids as your best manual times are what AFK runs are based on[/p][/*][*][p]AFKing a raid produces rewards much slower than raiding manually. The times it takes to complete an AFK raid is your best manual solo run time * 5 (at the time of writing). So if your best solo Reckoning of the Gods run is 10 minutes, an AFK Reckoning of the Gods run will take 50 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]You can't do another activity whilst AFK raiding[/p][/*][*][p]You don't receive experience from AFK raiding[/p][/*][*][p]You don't receive clan credits from AFK raiding[/p][/*][*][p]AFK raid completions are not counted towards your personal raid completions, leaderboards or the clan cup[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum AFK raid time is 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]You can AFK raid whilst offline, even up to the entire 3 days[/p][/*][*][p]Summed up, manual raiding is far superior to AFK raiding. But, if you're unable (or unwilling) to engage with raids manually, there is now an alternative option available[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Raids page has been slightly rearranged to display information in a more compact way. Also, you can now see your personal best solo runs in that view (not tracked at an individual level before this update so old run times won't show).[/p][/*][*][p]Bloodmoon massacre now remembers your previous bag loadout and lets you easily reselect it[/p][/*][*][p]Your best RotG time will now only be recorded if your ending party size matches your runs starting party size[/p][/*][*][p]Added Agility to the list of used skills in RotG and BMM as your dodge chance is now based on your agility level[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing player names in raid lobbies now shows the player's entire profile rather than just relevant skills[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]The item hover popup has been reworked to contain a lot more information[/b][/p][list][*][p]Current player market price (highest buy price or lowest sell price if there are no buy offers)[/p][/*][*][p]Stat differences compared to currently equipped item in same slot[/p][/*][*][p]Basic equipment info like level requirement, boosts etc[/p][/*][*][p]Applied and missing enchantments in jewelry[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Player info popup[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now used more often throughout the game when clicking player names in various places[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Invite to party" and "Join party" buttons for combat and raid parties[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small visual annoyance where UI elements would get shown before getting populated with the latest data. Things are now hidden until they are fully loaded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small issue where the levels of a viewed online player could be slightly out of date[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Chat messages[/b][/p][list][*][p]Left clicking/pressing chat messages now opens the player's info popup (same popup as used when viewing clan members)[/p][/*][*][p]Right clicking chat messages now copies the senders username to your clipboard[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Premium clarity changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]To be a bit less "in your face" with an in-app purchase, pressing premium locked content as a non-premium player will no longer straight up open up the game shop with premium benefits thrown at you. Instead, it'll open up a new popup that tells you a bit about the rank and lets you know that it can be bought with in-game gold as well. There are buttons that direct you both to the game shop and the player market with premium pre-searched[/p][/*][*][p]Reworded premium's description in the game shop to be a bit clearer about its tradeability and purchasability with in-game gold[/p][/*][*][p]When buying tokens from the game shop, you'll now automatically be taken to your inventory with the token selected to hopefully make it clearer that you need to activate the token to unlock its benefits[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Misc. QoL changes & additions[/b][/p][list][*][p]To not make the item requirements for the "Clan boss slayers" upgrade completely useless after you've unlocked the upgrade for your clan and to add another needed source of Otherworldly essence, these items can now be broken into essence[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing the placeholder toggle in your inventory page now displays a notification informing you of what you've done[/p][/*][*][p]The Valley of the Gods keys now mention which boss they unlock access to in their item descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]The player market page no longer needs to be opened before being able to list items for sale from your inventory[/p][/*][*][p]You'll now see how much potion usage you'll get when drinking potions[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of holiday currency you get from buying it via the game shop hasn't been modified in a long time, causing the deals to not be very worthwhile due to gold inflation. Thus, for future events, the amount of holiday currency you get has now been tripled[/p][/*][*][p]The "Get Questing token" button in the quests popup that shows up when you don't have the quester rank active was reworded to "Raise the amount of available quests with a Questing token", it's colour was changed and its pulse animation was removed[/p][/*][*][p]Ending solo combat now displays the more descriptive summary popup that was previously only used for group combat sessions[/p][/*][*][p]The detailed loot/kills summary popup is now accessible in solo combat as well via the "Loot and stats" popup. Historical loot is no longer displayed as text in that view[/p][/*][*][p]Health you lifesteal during a combat session can now be seen in the "Loot and stats" popup[/p][/*][*][p]Player market item searches are now able to display up to 40 different items, up from 20[/p][/*][*][p]Sobek is now a part of the weekly clan cup[/p][/*][*][p]"Yoink" now applies to offline boss kills[/p][/*][*][p]Local market upgrades now display max tier. Also, the tier text is now white[/p][/*][*][p]Lil' Eclipse now has an item description and mentions how its levelled up[/p][/*][*][p]The agility icon is now displayed in damage splats if the attack was dodged. Currently only in regular combat[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click player names in the clan recruitment centre to view their profiles[/p][/*][*][p]You can now click player names in clan boss lobbies to view their profiles[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing player names in combat lobbies now shows the player's entire profile rather than just relevant skills and equipment[/p][/*][*][p]If you're logging out or quitting the application without performing an offline supported activity, you'll now be warned that you'll go idle. On mobile, only log outs via the sidebar menu will trigger the warning[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused GIM accounts who were kicked out of a clan whilst being offline and who had an active task when logging out to be kicked out of the game shortly after logging back into the game due to an unhandled exception[/p][/*][*][p]The "Through the wetlands" upgrade was showing an incorrect percentage on non-English languages[/p][/*][*][p]A temporary chat channel being deleted will no longer default to the General chat being toggled on, unless the deleted chat was the chat you had open[/p][/*][*][p]The vault space bulk purchase now warns that you already have the maximum amount of vault space if you do[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed receiving skilling gloves not unlocking collection log slots. Should now work via the skilling party event and also via claimable items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where your raid lobby status wouldn't get cleared on logout, rendering you unable to, for example, join new raid parties after logging out or being disconnected until you manually cleared it by creating a new lobby or restarting the client[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where your BMM completion wouldn't be recorded if you left the raid before it finished. You would still receive rewards for it, but the run wouldn't be recorded to leaderboards, clan cup and with this update, your personal best runs[/p][/*][*][p]Damage dealt in Reckoning of the Gods and Bloodmoon massacre no longer overkills[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Kronos' weaknesses not being applied in combat[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly modified Ancient tribe drop table so that weights adds up to exactly 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Your current activity will no longer be marked as combat in your profile unless you're actually in combat (previously simply being in a combat lobby would suffice)[/p][/*][*][p]Doing smelting in RotG will no longer show you as idle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the attack skill not appearing in player info popups when viewing online players[/p][/*][*][p]The key used to open a boss lobby wouldn't be used towards offline progression, meaning that you'd end up with 1 less kill at the end of it than you should have[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Raid #3: Bloodmoon massacre | Potion changes & more
notes.notes:
[b]Our third raid is out: Bloodmoon massacre[/b]
[list]
[*] Infinite waves until your party inevitably falls. Each wave is harder than the last and the further you get, the better your chances at lucrative rewards
[*] You'll bring your own equipment into this raid. Additionally, you can by default bring up to 4 equipable items into the raid with you. This is doubled to 8 with the Bloodmoon preparation upgrade - more on that below
[*] As this raid doesn't have a defined end, the rewards work slightly differently from what you're used to. Boss fights start at wave 10 and repeat every 5 waves afterwards. After every boss fight, you'll receive a guaranteed default loot roll. On wave 20 and afterwards, you'll have a chance of receiving a high roller loot roll on top of the default roll. The chance of receiving this extra roll raises as you progress in the raid. High roller loot rolls are essentially 5x as powerful as default loot rolls. Received loot rolls are immediately recorded and will be usable later even if you suddenly leave the raid or disconnect.
[*] As this raid is never completed, leaderboards and clan cup don't count your completions like they typically do. Instead, they're are ordered by the wave you manage to get to. Bloodmoon massacre leaderboards and clan cup standings are available for both players and clans
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes & improvements
notes.notes:
- Exterminating auto completer can now be toggled on and off
  * It will always be on when you log in to prevent situations where you accidentally leave it off and miss out on offline gains. You can turn it off during your session when you want to switch Exterminating experts.
- Basilisk scale leather crafting tasks are now available
- Completionist capes can now be purchased without the required Exterminating level
- Some tasks from Eldric are now assigned in lower quantities
- Fixed the current assignment text not updating until you left and re-entered the Exterminating page if you were on that page when you completed the assignment
- The required Exterminating level is now mentioned when clicking Exterminating monsters
- The chance of being assigned monsters is now displayed in percentages rather than weights
- Exterminating monster entries now in the Exterminating page now have loot buttons to more easily see what they can drop
- Fixed the Cooking icon not appearing in enchanted items
- Exterminating is now tracked in clan cups
- Fixed Stone boots going into the wrong slot

[b]Important note[/b]: Exterminating isn't yet a requirement for the Completionist cape. However, it'll be added to the list of requirements a year after its release, so on 28th of October 2025. If you don't have requirements for the Completionist cape when the level requirement starts being enforced, any capes you're ineligible to wear will be stripped off of you and they'll be unequipable until you meet the new requirements. Any future skills will follow this model as well.

notes.title: 22nd of July - Pets and quests update part 2
notes.notes:
If you've been so lucky to receive pets before this update, gather them up because it's time for them to get to work!

[h1]Pets update[/h1]

[list]
[*] Skilling pets:
[list]
[*] Pets can now be levelled up. They share the same experience table as characters do
[*] Level up pets by sending them off to do tasks for you. Pets use the same tasks that are available to players, but the little fellas will take 4 times longer to complete tasks and do not use any unlocks you've made on your character such as upgrades. A slight difference is that pet tasks will never consume any gold, so Carpentry tasks for example won't cost you anything.
[*] You can only have a single pet to do a task for you at any given time
[*] When a pet completes their task, the produced item will be sent to your inventory. The pet will gain some experience and continue running the task just like your character would
[*] You will receive the experience your pet earns
[*] When completing tasks that have ingredient costs, pets will take the required items from your inventory
[list]
[*] Note: pets will skip the gold requirement if tasks have them (currently only Carpentry)
[/list]
[*] Pets will keep working when offline, just like your character does. Note: your character's offline progress if processed first, so if you both you and your pet are doing the same task whilst offline and you end up running out of resources, the pet might not end up producing anything
[*] As Agility and Enchanting tasks behave a bit differently from the others, so do the corresponding pets
[list]
[*] The Agility pet has a chance of finding you chests when completing tasks. The rate it finds them at is twice as high as normal. Other pets cannot find chests while skilling
[*] The Enchanting pet completes common, rare and exceptional tasks and earns itself and you experience without needing any scrolls. Not a lot of it, but hey, it's free!
[/list]
[*] While the rates might seem small at first, keep in mind that the activities the pets perform are completely separate from the player and everything you gain is just extra on top of whatever you're doing with your character. Introducing pets without them using existing modifiers will also allow us to more easily develop new content around pets.
[/list]
[*] Combat (Melee, Archery, Magic) pets:
[list]
[*] Received from daily & weekly combat quests at a higher chance than skilling pets. When completing combat quests, you'll receive one of these pets randomly. You won't receive duplicates until you've collected them all
[*] Combat pets behave very differently from skilling pets. They can not be sent off to do tasks for you, but rather you equip them to get the bonuses that they provide
[*] Combat pets receive a part of the experience you gain in combat when they're equipped. When certain experience thresholds are passed, you can upgrade your pet to the next tier and it'll provide higher bonuses
[*] Upgrading combat pets requires them to reach certain levels and costs gemstones and the costs from each tier carry over to the next one. For example, to upgrade to tier 2, you'll need 3 refined gemstones. Tier 3 takes 3 refined and great gemstones. Tier 4 takes 3 refined, great and elite gemstones, and so on
[/list]
[*] Pets have their own leaderboards 
[*] Manage your pets from the inventory tab
[/list]

[h1]Quest update[/h1]

[list]
[*] Weekly quests have been added
[list]
[*] Weekly quests consist of new some new quests that can take a while to complete, like finding gemstones from combat, and the same skilling quests seen in daily quests but with bigger numbers
[*] 4 weekly quests available by default, up to 6 with the quester rank
[*] Weekly quests have separate rerolls from dailies: 6 default, up to 12 with the quester rank
[*] Weekly quests can be auto-completed but daily quests are always prioritized
[/list]
[*] New types of quests have been added
[list]
[*] Receive a specific item as a drop from combat (the loot credit has to go to you)
[*] Kill an enemy X amount of times (you don't have to receive the kill credit in group combat)
[*] Kill an enemy in a single hit (only given as dailies). These expect you to utilize the potion of dark magic (though not strictly required) so low level ones aren't assigned to ironmen
[list]
[*] Note: combat quests cannot be auto completed and will be skipped when auto completing
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Previously, you wouldn't be able to get more than 1 quest for a given skill - this has now been modified so that you're able to reroll more quests for the same skill if previous quest(s) with that skill have already been completed. This doesn't apply to Enchanting quests
[/list]

[h1]Daily boosts[/h1]

[list]
[*] Ads have been removed from the game. Non-premium members on Steam can now claim daily boosts and mobile players aren't shown ads at all. You still need premium to bypass the cooldown and stack your daily boosts. This was done for a couple of reasons:
[list]
[*] Telling non-premium PC players to either play on mobile or pay up to access a feature in the game was pretty awkward and not a good experience for new users
[*] Displaying ads on top of the game client is fairly complicated and issues often pop up in frameworks that power them. These can cause a variety of problems such as crashes, which negatively affect how the game is being shown on stores and can result in less potential players finding out about our game
[*] The revenue received from ads wasn't significant enough to justify their existence
[/list]
[*] Additionally, claiming your daily boost will now credit you with all available boosts if you have premium
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes and smaller changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Login issues that have occasionally impacted a small amount of users recently are hopefully fixed. Will continue to monitor the systems and make further adjustements if needed.
[*] Equipment UI in the inventory tab has been overhauled! Hopefully it's more pleasant to look at now and easier to make sense of for new players

[*] The "You're about to sell x" text now uses delimiters
[*] When creating a sell offer for a premium token and cancelling it, an untradeable token would be added to your inventory client side (visual bug)
[*] To prevent unwanted tasks from starting, the quest action (auto complete etc) you selected is now completely cleared when logging out of the game and won't be remembered on your next sessionThe quest action selection popup where you select if you want quests to be auto completed etc. is now more descriptive
[*] You'll no longer receive the "Are you sure you want to leave this view? You'll lose any uncollected rewards." confirmation popup when being invited to group activities whilst having the event popup open. You used to claim the items manually once an event ended but that's now automatic so the confirmation is redundant

notes.title: 15th of May updates - Quality of Life changes & bug squashes
notes.notes:
The biggest changes in the update are backend ones. We've made lots of progress on and our backend systems are healthier than ever! Work on that front continues as we ensure our systems will be capable of running smoothly as the game and our player base grows.

The main changes that are visible to you as a player though would be the changes to player to player item sending and daily boosts. Read on!

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Player-to-player item sending changes. The item sending system was in need of a couple of tweaks to ensure that it'll continue to work as expected as we overhaul our backend systems this year for better scalability. Hopefully these changes will provide a more user friendly experience as well!
   [list]
   [*] Items can now be sent to offline players. Note: the recipients username is case insensitive but they'll need to log out once after this update lands for case insensitivity to work
   [*] Items are no longer directly added to the recipients inventory when sent - instead, they're added to an item withdrawal box which can be accessed from your profile. All items you receive from other players will be listed here and you'll need to claim them to add them to your inventory - or you can discard them if you don't appreciate someone's gift.
   [*] You can have 20 items from a specific player in your withdrawal box. Afterwards, you'll need to claim or discard the items for them to be able to send you more
   [*] Your item withdrawal box can hold 60 items in total
   [/list]
[*] Whitelisting system has been removed and you can now send items to anyone at any time. With these new changes in place, I believe the whitelisting system is just an extra step and an unnecessary headache as you'll now claim any items sent to you before they're added to your inventory
[*] Daily experience boost changes
   [list]
   [*] Premium players no longer have a 2h cooldown period when claiming daily boosts
   [*] Boost can be paused. After pausing and resuming the boost, there's a 3 minute cooldown before you can pause it again
   [*] Boost will not be consumed whilst offline if it's paused OR if you logged out whilst idle and the boost didn't get used on anything
   [*] 8 hours is still the limit per day and your boost carries over when days change. Your maximum boost time is 16 hours
   [/list]
[*] The settings popup now contains a "Blocks" tab where you can block other players. Blocking a player prevents them from sending you items, inviting you to combat and raids parties and you won't see their messages in chat
[*] Settings can now be accessed from main menu. The language dropdown was removed as a result as they can now be accessed from inside the settings popup
   [list]
   [*] Note: some tabs are unavailable in the main menu as their settings are player specific
   [/list]
[*] For better accuracy and to be less error prone, the combat stats calculations now uses session data to calculate your stats and are thus guaranteed to be accurate. There is also a "Simulate expected stats" which runs the simulation as it has done before so that you can instantly see what kind of stats you can expect to see with your current setup
[*] All smithable armour has been graphically reworked by ZoEzi!
[*] When listing an item for sale, the default price is now 0 instead of 1 and you'll be told to select a valid price if you attempt to list an item for 0 gold. This is to prevent accidental 1 gold sales that happen to the best of us from time to time
[*] Renamed Questing scroll to Questing token
[*] Default FPS target on mobile is now 30 instead of 60
[*] Excess whitespace is now removed from chat messages
[*] Added a loading screen to guest username updates and added a character limit to the input field
[*] Attempting to update your guest username to a name that's already taken will now tell you so rather than hitting you with the ambiguous "Operation couldn't be completed" error message
[*] Raids 1 & 2 have a new background
[*] A detailed error message is now displayed when you attempt to purchase items from the game shop on a standalone client that's been launched outside of Steam
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed some quests not showing the exclamation mark in the quests popup even if you didn't have the resources to complete them
[*] Fixed typo in the "You need to be connected to the chat to do this" message
[*] Fixed a bug where if you had the clan view open when you got kicked out of the clan, your old clan would remain visible (but you wouldn't be able to interact with it)
[*] Fixed an unnecessary desync disconnect that would occur if you initiated an item sale, left the confirmation popup open and your owned item amount was less than originally when you confirm the sale
[*] Chat input field no longer accepts rich text
[*] The minimum selectable value in the clan quest donation slider is now 1 instead of 0
[*] Quests popup is now closed if you have it open when quests regenerate
[*] Guest restrictions that weren't properly enforced before
   [list]
   [*] You can no longer accept invitations to clans until you've registered
   [*] You can no longer participate in group combat or raids until you've registered
   [*] You can no longer receive items from other players until you've registered
   [/list]
[/list]

notes.title: 9th of February update - Group finding, 2FA, improved item sending & more
notes.notes:
[b]Today's update brings in new ways to find party members to raid and do combat with, optional two-factor authentication to enhance your account security, improved item sending & more![/b]

[h2][b]New[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Group finding & lobbies[/b]
    [list]
    [*]You can find and join open lobbies created by other players in combat and in Reckoning of the Gods
        [list]
        [*]In Combat, the lobbies shown is based on the zone you're currently in. If you're currently in the Woods zone and press the "Open lobbies" button, you'll see only lobbies created against monsters in the Woods zone
        [/list]
    [*]To make your combat and Reckoning of the Gods public, the leader of a lobby needs to press the "Make lobby public" button once the party has been created
    [*]You can now view the stats and equipment of players in your combat lobby
    [*]You can now kick players from both Reckoning of the Gods and combat lobbies
    [*]If you've blocked a player or they've blocked you, you won't see their open lobbies and they won't see yours
    [/list]
[*][b]Optional Two-factor authentication[/b]
    [list]
    [*]SMS authentication has been added to enhance account security. You can turn it on from the 2FA button which can be found underneath the Settings button in the sidebar menu from the top right
    [*]When registering a phone number, you'll be sent a SMS with a one-time passcode. Enter the code into the 2FA popup and your phone number will be linked to your account
    [*]When logging onto an account with 2FA enabled from an unknown device, a one-time passcode will be sent to your device and you'll need to submit it to be able to log in. The passcode will never be requested when logging in from known and trusted devices
    [*]More 2FA options may be added in the future. SMS authentication is a simple solution both development wise and for user experience and it works well with small online games like ours. I know that many prefer 2FA by App though and that's definitely something I want to have another look at in the future
    [*]Two-factor authentication is currently not available to US users. For an application to send text messages to US phone numbers, it requires a separate business registration and vetting process, which is currently in progress. It should at most take a week or two to be finalized if no issues come up
    [/list]
[*][b]Improved player-to-player item sending[/b]
    [list]
    [*]The item sending popup was reworked to be more functional and offer new QoL features
    [*]When sending an item to another player, the recipient will be saved and you'll be able to quickly select them from a list of known players. Note that this history is saved on device so it won't carry over to other devices if you play on multiple platforms
    [*]When engaging in group activities such as combat and raids, the users you're playing with will be recorded and will be presented to you as "suggestions" when sending items, allowing you to easily send items to the right people when running bosses for example
    [/list]
[*][b]Clan security[/b]
    [list]
    [*]Attempting to delete a clan now triggers a 7-day grace period. If after 7 days you still want the clan to be deleted, you can do so. The process can be aborted at any time
    [/list]
[/list]
[h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Raid party chat is now created in the lobby already rather than waiting until the run begins
[*]Added "Max", "-1" and "+1" buttons to inventory item interaction popup, player shops item listing popup and the vault item interaction popup
[*]Untradeable items no longer show up when listing items in your personal shop
[*]Attack mastery capes descriptions now mention that they boost accuracy instead of damage
[*]Moved the item info panel of item inventory interaction popup slightly upwards so that items with a lot of bonuses (mastery capes) aren't partially cut off on some resolutions
[*]Changed "Guild" text to "Clan" in the clan logs popup. There are no guilds here.
[*]/unblock command in chat is no longer case sensitive
[*]Inviting your entire clan to events now has a 15 second cooldown. This was a last minute server-side change so there isn't any client side feedback for this - clan members just won't receive an invite if they've recently been invited. The cooldown applies to the entire event lobby
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an experience desync in clan combat experience events, which caused you to receive less experience than was visually portrayed. The difference wouldn't show up until you relogged
[*]Fixed clan credits appearing to be added to you every time you donated an item to a clan quest (visual bug)
[*]Fixed the clan quest donation popup not updating correctly if you lost the item being donated whilst having the popup open, causing there to be a desync and you being kicked from the game when you attempted to donate said item
[*]Fixed some of the new-ish enchanted items (brute bracelets etc.) not having a description
[*]When listing an item for sale in your player shop, the UI will now correctly update if your inventory is modified during listing
[*]When searching for players in the leaderboards that don't exist or don't have high enough levels to be included in leaderboards, you'll now be notified accordingly instead of being shown an empty leaderboards profile
[*]Fixed a chest bug where you if you'd get a rare chest you'd also get a normal chest and if you got an exceptional chest, you'd additionally get both a normal and rare chest. It was in the game for long enough, sorry all!
[*]When wearing a chef's hat, the amount an item heals is now updated accordingly when interacting with items in your inventory and hovering food in combat
[*]Fixed eating food directly from your inventory not counting in the chef's hat boost visually
[*]Slight group combat loot info popup UI tweaks
[*]Chef's hat's boost is now applied to the Picky Eater upgrade
[*]Fixed the "Keep it burning" upgrade cooking meat that you didn't have the level for - you just didn't receive the experience
[/list]

notes.title: 8th of August updates - Gilded rank (cosmetics), QoL updates & bug fixes
notes.notes:
There's an on-going poll regarding Ironman mode on our Discord in the #game-workshop channel. Check it out and leave a vote if the subject interests you!

[b]New[/b]
[list]
A new item has been added to the shop: Gilded. A good amount of players have been wanting to support the game beyond what is available in the shop currently, and I hope this is a decent enough answer to that! Nothing the rank contains will offer any gameplay/competitive advantage - it's all cosmetic or QoL at best. Similarly to Premium, purchasing it will grant you a token which can be activated or traded away. 

Here are the current benefits it provides:
[*] Gilded icon next to your name
[*] Ability to buy Cosmetic scrolls from the Local market for 1M gold each. These can be applied on equippable items for a cool effect. They do not alter the items' stats in any way and they are untradeable.
[*] You're unaffected by chat idle timeouts. On a slightly different note, timeouts for regular players were raised from 20 minutes of inactivity to 45. Kind of gathering data with how the timeouts will play with this update when it comes to resource usage. It's possible that chat timeouts are removed in the future all together, so I'd advise you not to get the rank for this benefit alone.
[/list]

More may come in the future, but nothing beyond the usefulness of the existing benefits.

This feels like a good time to give a special thanks to everyone who has supported the game so far, your contributions have been absolutely vital in the continued development and success of Idle Clans. I'm extremely grateful to be in a position to work on Idle Clans in this capacity and be able to make it the best game that it can be together with you all. Thank you!

[b]Changes & updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Hovering equipped items in your inventory will now show detailed information on the item instead of a simple "click to unequip" tooltip
[*] Chat idle timeout raised from 20 minutes to 45 minutes
[*] The text colour in premium benefits is now black for better readability
[*] Titles of categories in the Local market are now bigger
[*] "Send to clan vault" and "Send to player" buttons in inventory item interaction popup are now hidden if the interacted item is untradeable. NOTE: As a result of this change, the aforementioned buttons are incorrectly disabled for Gold on mobile devices. Works as it should on Steam, and fixes will follow for iOS and Android.
[*] Slightly modified how the shop unlocks are displayed in player profiles for a cleaner look

[*] Orientation of the game can now be rotated to the left as well as right on mobile devices

[*] Fixed there being a possibility of a raid party leader showing as "not ready" when remaking parties in a specific order
[*] Fixed swapping inventory item slots causing the active sorting to reset
[*] Chatbox input field is no longer automatically activated when opening the game chat on mobile devices
[*] Fixed an issue where the connection state checker client side would sometimes cause "Connection lost" popups to unnecessarily be shown in the login screen
[*] Fixed an issue in group combat lobbies where a player's UI entry would sometimes not be removed when they left their party
[*] Group combat lobbies will now correctly be disbanded when the leader leaves
[*] Active popups such as the inventory item hover popup will now close if they happen to be open while your raid party leader starts a raid
[*] Fixed a small issue where you could still see the "Preparation ending in x" text whilst in a raid battle
[*] Witches in Raids were using their strength level to carry out damage instead of their magic level, which made them significantly weaker than they should have been. Fixed.
[*] Fixed arrows not appearing to update in your combat equipment when equipping or unequipping arrows from your inventory
[*] Fixed an issue where going in and out of combat inbetween raids could cause some UI to get messed up
[*] Raid max party size wasn't being correctly enforced server side, fixed
[*] You can no longer be in group combat while being in a raid party
[*] Fixed Astronomical leather & flax not showing up under the correct inventory filters
[*] Attempting to accept an expired raid invitation will now properly clear the invitation
[/list]

notes.title: 26th of July patch notes - Raids bug fixes & QoL additions
notes.notes:
Hope everyone has been enjoying raids! Congrats to all lucky enough to get their hands on some of the rare drops so soon.

This update primarily addresses the few server crashes we've seen in the past days, bug fixes for raids and some small new features to make the update at least a little bit interesting. Enjoy!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new upgrade, "Lazy Raider". It costs 3M and once purchased, you will automatically restart your task from the previous preparation phase when entering subsequent preparations in Reckoning of the Gods
[*] Clans now track Health experience
[*] Health skill has been added to player and clan leaderboards. Note that your Health ranking won't show up in the leaderboards before logging out once.
[*] Animated experience and item drops will no longer block clicks. This was especially annoying in Raids.
[*] Being in a raid lobby or active raid will now show up as such in clan member profiles
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed party members readiness state having some occasional weirdness after runs. Everyone in the group should now be set as not ready when a run ends
[*] Fixed some UI not being activated when accepting a raid invitation from the combat view
[*] Fixed the server crashes we've seen since update
[*] Fixed an issue where after joining a raid during combat and relogging (without closing the client), you would be unable to join new raid parties
[*] Fixed an issue where you sometimes after relogs wouldn't be able to start raids as the leader of a party
[*] Fixed an issue where you sometimes after relogs wouldn't be sent to a starting raid as the member of a party
[*] Fixed an issue where setting your solo boss fight to end after the current round would cause the state to be carried over to the next boss fight
[*] Fixed raid participants indexes often going out of order when remaking parties
[*] Fixed an issue where the client sometimes wouldn't clear out arrows at amount 1 in raids vault (visual bug)
[*] Fixed a combat damage issue where if you died during raids and went straight to regular combat, your equipment from raids would be used to calculate your damage output instead of your actual gear
[*] Astronomical leather coat had a leather requirement of 4 and trousers 6, which was not how crafting requirements work in the rest of the game. Reversed their requirements.
[/list]

notes.title: 22nd of May updates - New upgrade, new plundering task, QoL changes & much more
notes.notes:
Starting off with a honourable mention for Noscar for kindly offering us his time and giving our website some much needed love. It looks exponentially better than it did before. Thank you Noscar!

The server has been running very smoothly since the last update and I'm starting to feel the pressure ease up from all of that. Lots of bugs have been squashed and there are still some less urgent ones left to deal with, but now with the bigger fires put out I'm starting to be able to focus on new content and more meaningful updates for the game. It's building up to be a great summer for Idle Clans!

From here on out, I'm going to commit to pushing an update biweekly. Updates may occasionally pop up more often than that if something urgent needs taking care of, or it could take longer if there's larger content update coming up that doesn't make it into the 2 week sprint. I'll be sure to update the community in those cases though. The next update target as such is 5th of June.

On to the game updates!
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] A new upgrade has been added: Boss slayer. It costs a modest 25M gold and once unlocked, will allow you to repeatedly fight the same boss until your keys run out. The upgrade works for groups too and if any group member has it unlocked, it'll be active for the group leader as well.
[*] A new popup has been added to group combat to better keep track of how the group is doing. It contains the collected loot + dealt & taken damage for each player in the group. It can be manually accessed from the "Loot and stats" view, but it will also show automatically when you leave a group or when the run comes to a natural end.
[*] A new Plundering task, the Sports center, has been added. It has a level 60 requirement to start and drops the new Agility training tool, the Jumping rope
[*] A new dish has been added: Beef stew! It has a level 80 requirement and heals 19 health upon consumption. You'll need 2 potatoes, 4 carrots and a piece of cooked quality meat to prepare it.
[*] Game rules have been added to our website and are accessible in the game from the settings popup
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changes to how boosts from enchantments and potions are applied. Currently in the game, they provide a flat bonus to your stats instead of multiplying your actual stats by a given percentage. This caused a very noticable imbalance in the game's combat, especially from mid-game onwards. You would stop taking damage from high level monsters much sooner than made sense and bosses would become too easy to take on even solo. For example, if you had a 50% chance to block attacks from demons and wore 4 pieces of diamond jewelry with defence enchantments, your block chance would raise from 50% to 70% (4x5%). The 20% will now be applied to your base 50% block chance instead of adding on top of it, so in this scenario you would now have a 60% block chance.
[*] As higher level players have already seen, the skilling speed cap (80%) is currently too easily obtainable and causes a greater influx of items throughout the game than what is good for the economy. In an effort to improve the balance here, housing upgrades and clan housing now give a flat experience boost to skills similarly to the ad boost rather than decreasing the time it takes to complete skilling tasks.
[*] Yoink chance has been lowered from 25% to 15%. 25% was decided upon when you were still limited to having 1 key a a time. Now with the design of that changed, Yoink needed a little bit of fine tuning as well
[*] Combat will now continue on log in after combat offline progress
[*] Rewrote the login limiter system. You should no longer incorrectly be locked out from the game on any OS/platform
[*] Idle Clans Bot will now include the player receiving loot and the loot itself in the "boss defeated" message
[*] Bosses now drop ore instead of bars and raw food in place of cooked food
[*] Max experience in a skill is now 500M
[*] Experience in maxed skills will no longer show as "Maxed" but keep on showing the experience post-120
[*] Potion of forgery will no longer work on Astronomical bars
[*] Confirmation popup will now be shown when attempting to sell enchanted gear and tools
[*] Gemstones, clubs and the Royal clan icon have had their graphics updated (ty Madao!)
[*] Small city plundering task requirement was lowered from 55 to 50
[*] Premium and boss hunter status are now shown at the bottom right of the profile where boosts used to be
[*] Tasks now display how many of the relevant items you own
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Enchanting level requirements not being enforced correctly client side when dragging scrolls from inventory to equipment
[*] Zeus had a higher chance of dropping nothing than intended, fixed
[*] Fixed some mistakes in client side DPS calcs. Additionally, as combat uses a high amount of RNG, simulations are now ran in the client side calcs to provide more realistic calculations. As a result, you'll see slightly different hit chances and DPS each time you open the damage calcs popup.
[*] Fixed an issue with ad boost and offline progress. The experience boost was correctly factored in on the server, but the server was sending the unmodified experience to the client causing you to see incorrect numbers on login
[*] Fixed damage dealt during offline combat being shown incorrectly when you had an ad boost active during offline time
[*] Fixed a visual experience desync that would occasionally occur when resuming an offline task upon logging in
[*] Fixed whitelists not resetting when logging from one account to another when the second account didn't have any whitelisted players
[*] Fixed a visual issue with ad boost calculations in Task stats popup
[*] Accounts logged out during a tutorial task had some trouble processing offline progress tasks when they logged back in. Offline progress is now disabled for players that are in the middle of the tutorial.
[*] Fixed loot tables never rolling the highest amount available (e.g. the 1-2 Exceptional chest drop from bosses would only ever drop 1 chest)
[*] Rewrote automatic eating in combat, should no longer get the rare issue in group combat where swapping food slots throws an error and causes the team to disband
[*] Fixed bosses being potentially accessible without enforcing the key requirement if you knew your way around the client and packet protocols. Thanks kloppie5 for finding the issue and reporting it
[*] Removed the "Doing this will end group combat" confirmation request popup when the player tried to start another task while in group combat. That is no longer how it works.
[*] Fixed enemies starting at no health instead of their actual max health in offline progress logic
[*] Fixed experience and item animations occasionally stopping animating after relogs
[*] Fixed an issue where if you tried to send an item to another player that you no longer owned you would get a never ending loading animation
[*] Fixed an annoying issue where sending private messages would sometimes throw you into the incorrect chatbox channel
[*] When a chat was removed from your chatbox, such as the combat team channel upon your team being disbanded, you would get sent to the default channel. You will now only be sent to the general channel if you were currently active in the channel that was deleted
[*] Fixed an issue with group combat eating
[*] Combat panels will now correct themselves to their original positions if they get messed up due to resolution changes
[*] Hopefully fixed the issue with clan quests not always immediately resetting on day change
[*] Slightly modified how the Costs part of tasks with resources are displayed so that tasks with a lot of resource costs don't have their font sizes scaled down
[*] Boss runs will now end if a player leaves and the remaining member(s) are dead
[*] Fixed deaths in group combat sometimes leaving the dying player at non-zero health and the RIP panel not always appearing
[/list]

notes.title: May 1st updates - In-app purchase & design changes, bug fixes & more
notes.notes:
[b]Changes
[/b]
[list]
[*] In app purchase changes
- The Clan Credits boost in-app purchase has been disabled. It created an unfair field for clans to compete in and frankly made obtaining credits too easy for large, active clans.
- The Gemstone boost has been disabled. Similar reasoning as with credit boosts, the amount of gemstones introduced via the boost created unbalanced progression and a greater influx of gemstones than what I deem to be healthy for both the game's economy and individual player progression alike.
-  A new IAP that's more fair in nature has been added. The "Boss hunter" is a tradeable and consumable token that allows you to hold an unlimited amount of boss keys.
- When buying Premium membership tokens from other players, you will now need to pay a fee of 1M gold to make it tradeable again. This change is to prevent excessive flipping of the token which artificially drives up the price of tokens and makes it more difficult for new players to get their hands on premium.
[*] Boss changes
- Zeus has been buffed
- Only Zeus and Hades now drop Wands of Lifesteal. Titanium gloves and boots have been removed from their drop tables and are only obtainable from the other bosses.
[*] Smithing changes
- Coal is now required for all bars that are smithed into armour
- Armour smithing has had its base time raised from 3s to 9s
[*] Clan credits changes
- Credits per boss drop kill dropped from 20 to 12
- Credits per clan quest completion raised from 10 to 16
- Clan skilling quests will now only offer tasks up to level 50 instead of the previous 60. Additionally, the amounts required to complete tasks were lowered.
[*] Combat groups will no longer be disbanded when someone in the group leaves. Applies to both regular monsters and bosses.
[*] Removed hatchet and pickaxe from Local market
[*] Novice's wand was added to drop table of Druids
[*] Farming trickery upgrade prices have been rebalanced (now more expensive)
[*] The total level requirement to chat no longer applies to premium players
[*] Server optimizations, as usual
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed daily boosts not being claimable after the daily reset until you relogged
[*] Fixed Ninja upgrade not being applied to client side calculations
[*] "Leave/return to combat" overlay no longer overlaps with clan tabs
[*] Fixed "Leave/return to combat" overlay buttons overlapping with each other on some mobile aspect ratios
[*] Fixed an issue where you weren't able to start Carpentry tasks if you didn't have enough gold to pay for the tasks, even if the purchased Plank bargain upgrade made that untrue
[*] Potion of Trickery now only gets triggered on gathering tasks
[*] The "Already logged in" popup now won't close from background clicks to prevent misclicks, you'll now need to press decline or accept to continue
[*] Equipment boosts in profile now show 1 decimal place instead of doing weird rounding
[*] Fixed clan skills not gaining experience after level 80
[*] Godlike secateurs had a Fishing requirement instead of Foraging. Fixed.
[*] Fixed tasks sometimes showing an unnecessary amount of decimal points in experience gain
[*] Fixed Godlike refinements not receiving an experience boost from items
[*] Fixed a bug with Smelting magic upgrade giving less ore back than it should have during offline progression
[*] Fixed group combat edge-case bug causing groups to get disbanded. There might still be an issue with this - so far unable to find anything in testing but we'll see!
[*] Fixed loot from bosses not being displayed in solo runs (though it was given)
[/list]
